origin_hashes: PROVENANCE.json file_sha256 remains the immutable vendored input
scope: v1: keep registered transport capacity, main barriers/credits, hybrid dispatch and all main combine kernels unchanged; the v2.1 entries below record where the role path now differs.
Validate full-width real expert IDs and duplicate experts before route-derived indexing in both direct-dispatch routing loops; preserve -1 padding and destination-rank deduplication.
Fuse only noncached, nondeterministic role dispatch in one logical NVLink domain; deterministic and other logical paths retain the separate route guard and completion helpers.
Assert every incoming source count is zero in the main notify phase; use existing normal stream events and tensor lifetimes instead of empty-side completion kernels on the fused path.
Allocate no source receive rows; bound worker receive rows by explicit source count.
Read actual device counts after reducing allocation bounds; preserve hybrid forwarding metadata.
Known-empty sources return zero host counts without CPU polling or per-dispatch host counter clears; device counter resets and launch flags remain unchanged.
Expose compiled and loaded NCCL versions for startup compatibility checks.

v2.1: role-aware direct-NVLink dispatch and combine skip their entry barriers on every rank; ordered complete pairs, non-PDL main kernels and the unchanged exit barriers imply buffer, counter and count-inbox availability (proof in afdep_roles.hpp). AFDEP_KEEP_ENTRY_BARRIERS=1 restores them as a measurement control.

v2.1: role-aware direct-NVLink dispatch exchanges counts Attention->FFN only: sources reduce and send FFN rank/expert counts and wait for none; FFNs skip their zero-count reduction and wait only for source counts; prefix sums keep canonical positions. AFDEP_UNION_NOTIFY=1 restores the union exchange as a measurement control.

v2.1: role-aware direct-NVLink dispatch and combine replace their all-rank exit barriers with directed arrival: senders flush, grid-sync and release per-peer monotonic counters (unused scale-out channel-tail workspace in direct mode); only receivers wait. AFDEP_ALL_RANK_EXIT=1 restores the exit barriers as a measurement control.

v2.1: role-sized registered buffers. In one NVLink domain the role path sizes FFN dispatch inboxes for the Attention sources only (source s writes region s - F; the copy epilogue reads with the same offset) and, in the rank layout, Attention combine inboxes for the F FFN senders only; every rank registers the same maximum. AFDEP_UNION_BUFFERS=1 keeps union sizing as a measurement control.

v2.1: with directed exit, each sending CTA (Attention sources in dispatch, FFN ranks in combine) releases its own arrival after its TMA stores complete, without the sender grid sync; receivers wait for round x sender CTAs and the last source CTA resets the slot counters. AFDEP_GRID_SYNC_EXIT=1 keeps the grid-synced release as a measurement control.

v2.1: directional hybrid protocol when every scale-out (NVLink) domain holds one role: Attention domains send counts, payloads and finish tails to FFN domains only and skip forwarding and combine reduction; FFN domains skip scale-out sends, wait only for Attention domains, and signal combine arrival to Attention domains only. Both hybrid entry barriers keep only their scale-up half, and Attention domains (which then share no state) skip their scale-up barriers too. AFDEP_UNION_HYBRID=1 keeps the union hybrid protocol as a measurement control.

v2.1: directional hybrid dispatch validates full-width real expert IDs and duplicates in its notify and scale-out warps before route-derived indexing, stores or puts, as the direct path does, and drops the separate route-guard kernel ahead of each source dispatch; mixed-role (union hybrid) layouts keep the guard. AFDEP_HYBRID_ROUTE_GUARD=1 keeps the guard kernel as a measurement control.
scope_version: afdEP v1 role specialization + v2.1 entry barriers, directional counts, directed exit, per-CTA arrival release, role-sized buffers and the directional hybrid protocol
